results.title: Senior Director: Mobility Planner
results.description: In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next! At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. Job Description **Join a Landmark Giga-Project Shaping the Future of Saudi Arabia** Our client is delivering one of the Kingdom’s most ambitious and high-profile giga-projects, set to redefine global standards in destination development, innovation, and visitor experience. As part of the integrated Delivery Partner team, you will play a key role in planning, designing, and implementing world-class assets and infrastructure that support the Kingdom’s Vision 2030. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a pioneering program at scale, working alongside industry-leading experts, cutting-edge technologies, and diverse stakeholders. If you are driven by challenge, motivated by impact, and eager to be part of a legacy project that will influence generations to come, we invite you to consider joining this transformative journey. The Senior Director: Mobility Planner is the ultimate technical, operational, and strategic authority responsible for the end-to-end planning, efficiency, and day-to-day management of the city’s multi-modal mobility network. With a mandate requiring extensive distinguished leadership experience, this executive-level leader oversees the live operations of the entire transportation ecosystem. This includes public transit systems, autonomous shuttle corridors, active mobility trails, parking networks, micro-mobility, and intelligent traffic management systems. Sitting firmly within the O&M division, this role focuses on maximizing network throughput, minimizing congestion, deploying next-generation smart-city mobility technologies, and ensuring safe, seamless, and sustainable journeys for millions of annual residents and visitors. Key Responsibilities Multi-Modal Network & Transit Operations (O&M) Direct the daily operations, transit scheduling, and fleet management of all public and private transportation systems, including buses, light rail/monorail, micro-mobility, and autonomous mass transit networks. Oversee the strategic implementation of active mobility frameworks, managing pedestrian corridors, bike networks, and scooter-sharing infrastructure to ensure perfect connectivity between major city hubs and entertainment districts. Serve as the principal authority for high-footfall event transport planning, designing mega-crowd traffic diversion models, park-and-ride strategies, and flexible transit surges to handle peak visitor loads seamlessly. Formulate robust emergency transportation plans, network redundancy routes, and incident-response protocols to guarantee zero-disruption mobility during grid failures or civil emergencies. Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) & Traffic Engineering Direct the operational deployment and tuning of the city's Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), including adaptive traffic signals, automated speed enforcement, and real-time transit information displays. Partner with the digital city operations hub to leverage real-time traffic flow telemetry, predictive AI congestion mapping, and IoT sensor loops to optimize vehicle movements city-wide. Act as the technical authority for the city's smart car parks, integrating automated parking guidance systems (PGS), automated billing, license plate recognition (LPR), and electric vehicle (EV) charging grids with the broader mobility network. Financial Cost Recovery & Asset Integration Translate multi-modal usage logs, public transit ticketing data, and shared mobility fees into automated financial models for corporate finance teams. Provide the Service Charge Director with audited transit-wear metrics to ensure equitable infrastructure cross-charging, charging commercial zones, theme parks, and venues their fair share for the mobility infrastructure feeding their districts. Collaborate with the Asset Lifecycle Planning (LCP) division to map out multi-decade Capital Asset Replacement Plans (CARP) for core mobility infrastructure (e.g., transit fleets, smart charging arrays, signals, and ITS servers). Partner with the SAP-EAMS team to ensure every vehicle, charging dock, traffic sensor, and transit station is assigned a flawless digital ID for data-driven, predictive maintenance scheduling. Stage-Gate Handover & Design Advisory Serve as the primary mobility gatekeeper on the Stage-Gate Handover Committee, auditing traffic impact assessments (TIAs) and multi-modal readiness before newly constructed transit corridors or roads transition into live city operations. Formulate rigorous testing and commissioning verification rules for all transit fleets and smart ITS software networks prior to full operational adoption from builders and vendors. Job Requirements & Qualifications Education & Professional Credentials Bachelor’s Degree in Transportation Planning, Civil Engineering, Urban Design, Traffic Engineering, or a highly relevant quantitative technical discipline from an accredited institution. Master’s Degree in Transportation Engineering, Smart Mobility, Urban Planning, or an MBA from a globally recognized institution is highly preferred. Professional Certifications: Active senior professional registration, such as a Chartered Engineer (CEng), Professional Engineer (PE), or certification from the American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) / Institute of Transportation Engineers (ITE). Experience 25+ years of progressive, distinguished leadership experience in multi-modal urban transit planning, large-scale traffic engineering, or smart city mobility operations. At least 8 years in a senior executive or director-level capacity, directly managing multi-disciplinary transport teams and multi-million-dollar mobility operational and capital budgets (OPEX/CAPEX). Proven track record of spearheading the operational setup, network routing, or post-construction integration of giga-scale mass transit networks, autonomous vehicle testbeds, or smart-city traffic frameworks. Deep experience navigating micro-mobility logistics, fleet electrification challenges, demand-side traffic management, and Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 sustainability and smart city targets. Technical & Soft Skills Deep technical command over macro and micro traffic simulation modeling software (e.g., PTV VISSIM, VISUM, Synchro, or equivalent platforms). Executive-level fluency in transport operational technologies, including fleet telematics, automated fare collection (AFC) engines, and SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAMS) integrations. Exceptional executive presence and stakeholder management skills, with a demonstrated ability to present complex multi-modal transit strategies and traffic data to fin

results.title: Senior Director – Autonomous Mobility
results.description: We are seeking an experienced Senior Director – Autonomous Mobility to lead the establishment, commercialization, and scaling of a new autonomous mobility business in the region. This is a high-impact business leadership role with end-to-end accountability for strategy, P&L, commercialization, regulatory engagement, strategic partnerships, operations, and organizational development. Qualifications MBA or advanced degree in Business, Engineering, Logistics, Technology, Mobility, or a related discipline. 10–15 years of relevant experience in mobility, logistics, CEP, autonomous vehicles, smart mobility, or adjacent technology-enabled sectors. Significant experience in the UAE or GCC is strongly preferred. Proven track record of launching, scaling, and commercializing new businesses, products, or technology-enabled services. Demonstrated P&L ownership and strong commercial track record. Experience working in startup, venture-building, transformation, or high-growth environments. Strong experience engaging with government and regulatory stakeholders. Experience with public-private partnerships or government-led innovation programs is highly desirable. Strong knowledge of the mobility and CEP sectors, including smart cities, urban logistics, last-mile delivery economics, and operating models. Practical understanding of autonomous vehicle technologies, deployment models, safety requirements, and operational considerations. Key Responsibilities Define and execute the business strategy for autonomous mobility, aligned with the organization’s growth and innovation agenda. Develop scalable commercial models for autonomous mobility solutions across public roads, campuses, private developments, and other relevant environments. Own the business P&L, including revenue growth, cost management, investment planning, and overall financial performance. Lead go-to-market strategy, pricing, customer acquisition, commercial pipeline development, and strategic partnerships. Develop and execute autonomous vehicle deployment programs from business case and pilot through to commercial scale. Lead engagement with UAE regulatory and government authorities to secure approvals and enable compliant operations. Establish strong governance across safety, regulatory compliance, cybersecurity, data privacy, operational performance, and risk management. Build strategic partnerships with CEP operators, e-commerce platforms, retailers, government entities, real estate developers, technology providers, and other ecosystem stakeholders. Identify opportunities to expand into adjacent autonomous technologies, including robotics, autonomous ground vehicles, drones, and other emerging solutions. Translate technology capabilities into commercially viable and scalable customer solutions. Build and lead a high-performing team while fostering an entrepreneurial, execution-focused culture. Represent the business with senior government, industry, technology, and commercial stakeholders. Provide strategic, financial, and operational updates to the GCEO and executive leadership.

results.title: Transportation Supervisor
results.description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced Transport Supervisor to oversee and coordinate daily transportation operations between the Distribution Center (DC) and assigned dark store locations across Kuwait . The role will be responsible for ensuring the timely and efficient movement of goods from the DC to dark stores, managing delivery routes and schedules, overseeing truck fleet operations and utilization , monitoring driver performance, and maintaining high standards of operational efficiency and service quality. The Transport Supervisor will also be responsible for route planning and optimization, delivery allocation, truck fleet management, vehicle utilization and availability, driver coordination, transportation performance tracking, and managing operational issues and delays . The role will work closely with DC and dark store teams to ensure smooth and reliable replenishment operations, minimize delivery delays, optimize transportation resources, and ensure that dark stores receive the required inventory on time. Key Responsibilities Manage daily transportation operations from the Distribution Center (DC) to assigned dark store locations , ensuring timely, safe, and efficient movement of goods and smooth execution of replenishment plans. Plan, coordinate, and optimize transport routes, delivery schedules, truck allocation, and delivery capacity based on business requirements, store demand, and operational priorities. Manage and monitor the truck fleet , including vehicle availability, utilization, deployment, maintenance coordination, and overall fleet efficiency. Coordinate and supervise drivers and transport teams , ensuring adherence to delivery schedules, assigned routes, operational procedures, safety requirements, and service standards. Monitor daily transportation performance and key KPIs, including on-time delivery, route efficiency, vehicle utilization, delivery turnaround time, transportation costs, and service quality . Track deliveries in real time, identify delays, route deviations, vehicle issues, and other transportation exceptions, and take timely corrective actions to minimize operational disruptions. Coordinate closely with DC, dark store, warehouse, operations, and other relevant teams to ensure accurate loading, dispatch, receiving, and timely replenishment of dark stores. Identify, investigate, and resolve transportation-related operational issues and delivery exceptions, conducting root-cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions. Analyze transportation data and operational trends to identify opportunities for route optimization, fleet utilization, cost reduction, and process improvement . Ensure compliance with company transportation policies, fleet safety standards, vehicle requirements, driver procedures, and applicable local regulations . Oversee the training and development of drivers and transport team members, ensuring they have the required operational knowledge, safety awareness, and service standards. Prepare regular transportation performance reports and provide data-driven insights and recommendations to management on fleet performance, route efficiency, operational issues, and improvement opportunities. Support the development and continuous optimization of transportation processes, route planning, fleet management, and DC-to-dark-store delivery operations to improve efficiency, reliability, and overall service quality. Job Requirements Bachelor's degree or higher in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration , or a related field; alternatively, 3+ years of relevant experience in transport, logistics, or delivery operations . Proven experience in delivery, transport, logistics, fleet, preferably within a fast-paced e-commerce or delivery environment. Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational data and identify performance improvement opportunities. Strong execution and follow-up skills, with the ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Good project management and process improvement capabilities. Fluent in English , with strong written and verbal communication skills. Willingness to be based in Kuwait and work according to operational requirements, including flexible working hours when necessary.

results.title: Logistics & Fleet Analyst
results.description: Job Summary We are looking for a Logistics & Fleet Analyst to support our day-to-day transportation, fleet, driver, Sales invoices, and logistics operations. The role will be responsible for monitoring fleet performance, coordinating trucks and drivers, analyzing logistics costs, Sales invoices , maintaining accurate records, and supporting efficient delivery operations. Key Responsibilities Coordinate daily Sales Invoices / truck and driver allocation based on delivery requirements. Monitor truck utilization, delivery schedules, routes, and vehicle availability. Coordinate with Warehouse, Sales, and Logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries. Monitor driver attendance, trips, working hours, and performance. Maintain accurate fleet, driver, vehicle, and delivery records. Track fuel consumption, maintenance, repair costs, and other fleet-related expenses. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly fleet and logistics performance reports. Analyze transportation costs and identify opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvement. Monitor delivery performance, including delays, trip completion, and POD status. Support the preparation and processing of sales invoices and delivery-related documents, where required. Work closely with external transporters and service providers when required. Develop and maintain Excel-based trackers and dashboards for fleet and logistics KPIs. Support management with logistics data analysis, forecasting, and operational reports. Ensure compliance with company policies, safety requirements, and local transportation regulations. Qualifications & Requirements Minimum 3 years relevant experience in Kuwait / GCC Logistics, Fleet Management, Transportation Bachelor’s Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS/COUNTIFS, and data analysis. Experience with ERP, WMS, TMS, fleet management systems, or other logistics software. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to prepare and interpret logistics and fleet performance reports.. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple operational priorities. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Good command of English; Arabic is an advantage.

results.title: Manager, Micro Mobility Operations
results.description: Redefining Land, Air, and Sea Travel… Elevating Destinations. Coastal Transportation Services Co., a Red Sea Global Subsidiary Coastal Transportation Services Company, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, provides Transportation services at our Red Sea destination and is part of the Red Sea Global Group of companies. We specialize in providing transportation services to our Red Sea destination. As a subsidiary, Coastal Transportation Services Co. benefits from shared strategic goals and collaborative initiatives within the Red Sea Global group of companies, enhancing our ability to serve our clients effectively. Are you ready to transform the future of transportation? At Coastal Transportation Services Co., we are driven by innovation, creativity, and a passion for redefining transportation. Our team is shaping the future with cutting-edge projects, from autonomous vehicles to sustainable transportation solutions. We are seeking forward-thinking individuals eager to collaborate in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where ideas become reality. Join us in revolutionizing transportation and creating a smarter, more sustainable world—one innovation at a time. Join our visionary team and help shape the future of transportation! This role is responsible for ensuring seamless delivery of buggy, e-bike, and other micro mobility solutions, supporting the wider Mobility strategy. The position holds accountability for service delivery, stakeholder engagement, team leadership and operational efficiency in a 24/7 environment. Key Responsibilities: Service Operations Leadership Manage daily micro mobility operations across multiple service types and locations. Ensure service continuity, timely asset availability and operational resilience. Support integration of new modes (e.g., e-bikes, scooters) as part of service expansion. Team and Resource Management Lead supervisory staff, operators, and support teams across the micro mobility network. Set clear expectations and performance standards aligned with safety and customer service. Oversee training, onboarding, and staff scheduling to meet service requirements. Performance and Compliance Oversight Ensure all services operate within regulatory, safety and policy frameworks. Monitor service metrics and deliver improvement plans to enhance efficiency and user satisfaction. Implement incident management protocols and ensure timely resolution of issues. Work cross-functionally with departments including Land Operations, TOCC, Maintenance and Projects. Liaise with vendors and partners to support service delivery and infrastructure readiness. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across functions and resolve challenges quickly. Operational mindset with the ability to lead services at both strategic and frontline levels. Adaptable and resourceful, with a commitment to service excellence.

results.title: Logistics Manager
results.description: About the Role We are seeking an experienced Logistics Manager to lead day-to-day logistics, warehouse, and distribution operations. This is a hands-on operational leadership role responsible for ensuring goods move efficiently from receiving through to final delivery, managing a team, and hitting service-level and cost targets. What You'll Do Oversee daily warehouse operations, including receiving, put-away, storage, picking, packing, and outbound shipping. Manage transportation and distribution planning, including carrier coordination, route/delivery scheduling, and freight cost control. Ensure inventory accuracy through regular cycle counts, reconciliation, and discipline around stock movement processes. Monitor and report on logistics KPIs: on-time delivery, order accuracy, freight cost per unit, warehouse utilization, and fulfillment lead time. Manage relationships with carriers, freight forwarders, and third-party logistics (3PL) providers, including performance reviews and rate negotiations. Lead, schedule, and develop the warehouse and logistics team, including hiring, training, and performance management. Enforce safety standards and ensure compliance with health, safety, and regulatory requirements in the warehouse. Identify and implement process improvements to increase throughput, reduce cost, and reduce errors (e.g., layout optimization, WMS utilization, automation). Coordinate with Procurement, Sales, and Customer Service to align inbound supply and outbound delivery with demand. Manage the logistics/warehouse operating budget and control costs against targets. Handle escalations related to shipping delays, damaged goods, or delivery issues. What We're Looking For Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 5-8 years of experience in logistics, warehouse, or distribution operations, including 2+ years in a supervisory or management role. Strong working knowledge of warehouse management systems (WMS), inventory control practices, and transportation management. Experience managing carriers, 3PLs, and freight negotiations. Solid understanding of warehouse safety standards and regulatory compliance. Strong leadership and team management skills, with experience supervising warehouse/logistics staff. Analytical mindset with the ability to track KPIs and drive continuous improvement. Proficiency with ERP/WMS systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or similar). Certification in logistics or supply chain (e.g., CLTD, CSCP) is a plus.

results.title: ZAIN2433 - Inventory & Logistics Team Leader/Manager
results.description: About The Role The Inventory & Logistics Manager is responsible for leading inventory and logistics operations to ensure efficient stock management, timely shipment clearance, product availability, and seamless distribution across all sales channels. The role oversees inventory planning, logistics processes, warehouse operations, and supplier coordination while ensuring operational excellence, compliance, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities Lead inventory and logistics operations to ensure timely delivery and fulfilment of business requirements. Oversee shipment clearance, customs processes, and supplier deliveries until inventory is received and distributed. Manage inventory planning, stock replenishment, and buffer stock levels to maintain product availability. Oversee SIM cards, recharge cards, devices, and commercial/non-commercial inventory lifecycle management. Ensure effective warehouse operations, stock classification, item coding, and inventory accuracy. Manage return-to-vendor (RTV) activities, logistics coordination, and supplier returns. Monitor inventory KPIs and implement actions to improve operational efficiency and inventory performance. Collaborate with Procurement, Finance, Sales, Warehouse, IT, and Logistics teams to support business objectives. Identify process improvement opportunities and lead inventory and logistics optimization initiatives.
